prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save your new pet to your account", "Sign in now to keep your companion synced across your desktop devices."]
1: ["How to interact with your pet", "Drag your pet anywhere on desktop, right-click for options, or double-click to open chat.", "Right-click your pet at any time to hide or adjust settings."]
2: ["Welcome your new companion home", "Give your pet a name"]
3: ["Your pet is getting ready...", "Play while you wait", "Toss treats to your pet companion while background setup finishes.", "Your pet will appear on your desktop as soon as setup completes!"]
4: ["Signing in with your existing account email restores your adopted pets and desktop settings automatically."]
5: ["Your pet is live on your desktop!", "Look at the bottom right corner of your screen. Click your pet to start interacting immediately.", "Start Playing"]
6: ["Creating your desktop pet...", "Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on desktop by clicking and dragging."]
7: ["How would you like to start?", "Pick a ready-to-play template or create a fully customized companion pet."]
8: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop!"]
9: ["Choose your desktop pet", "Includes Free Starter Toy Pack & Treats"]
